tech.summary: OpenAI is racing to lock in investor commitments for a ~$30B round at over $1.4T valuation before rival Anthropic's expected mid-November IPO lets investors compare the two labs side by side. SoftBank, Abu Dhabi's MGX and sovereign funds are in talks; OpenAI pitched $50B annualised revenue (heading to $70B) after the GPT-6 Astra launch.
tech.title: OpenAI races to raise $30B at $1.4T valuation before Anthropic's IPO

tech.summary: The Department of Homeland Security ordered all federal civilian agencies to stop buying and remove DeepSeek products — including third-party tools built on DeepSeek models — from government IT systems, citing 'multiple threat vectors' and risks of sensitive data reaching China. China accused the US of politicising tech; the FCC votes Oct 29 on barring Chinese labs from device testing.
tech.title: US orders federal agencies to rip out DeepSeek from all government systems

tech.summary: Anthropic will put 5% of its equity — potentially ~$100B at IPO — into a new public benefit fund to cushion AI's impact on jobs, with 2% more added for every 50% rise in valuation. Co-founders pledged 80% of their holdings and staff get donation matching, taking ~20% of shares to public purposes. Critics note junior hiring has already slumped as AI agents take work.
tech.title: Anthropic pledges 5% equity to public benefit fund to offset AI job shocks

tech.summary: Mistral launched Voxtral 3 — a voice agent stack with speech-to-text in 50+ languages, emotion-aware text-to-speech in 35+ languages/50+ dialects, and a LiveKit-based SDK that streams listening, reasoning, tool calls and speaking in one pipeline. It claims sub-500ms realtime transcription and pricing that undercuts OpenAI, ElevenLabs and Deepgram.
tech.title: Mistral launches Voxtral 3 voice agent stack with 50+ language speech

tech.summary: Elon Musk confirmed on SpaceX's Q3 earnings call that both boards formed independent committees — at shareholders' request — to review a merger that would be the biggest corporate tie-up ever. Musk recused himself as a 'conflicted party', calling it an 'odd kabuki dance'. He cites superintelligence software, robotics, the Starmind orbital AI datacenters and Terafab chips as synergies; Tesla needs a 50% shareholder vote.
tech.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form committees to explore historic merger

tech.summary: Strong earnings revived the AI trade: SpaceX net income more than doubled estimates (shares +8%), Super Micro surged 15% post-market, and the Kospi jumped 3% on chip giants SK Hynix and Samsung. Elice surged 30% in Seoul while Australia's Nextdc crashed 45% on a cut outlook. Nasdaq 100 futures rose 1% as eyes turn to Meta and Tesla earnings today.
tech.title: AI-trade revival: Asian shares rally as SpaceX and Super Micro beat

pakistan.summary: President Zardari met IMF's Jihad Azour at Aiwan-e-Sadr and promised Pakistan is moving from stabilisation to recovery — economy at $452.1 billion in FY2026, real GDP growth up to 3.7%, fiscal deficit down to 2.6% and a primary surplus for the third straight year. IMF acknowledged the reform momentum ahead of the two-day tax reform workshop in Islamabad.
pakistan.title: Zardari tells IMF Pakistan is 'committed to fiscal sustainability' as economy hits $452.1B

pakistan.summary: Under the new daily pricing mechanism, petrol jumps 88 paisas to Rs382.02/litre and diesel 53 paisas to Rs389.80/litre for Wednesday — a day after a Rs5.16 cut. The Rs100/litre relief scheme for bikes and 800cc cars (11.8 million beneficiaries) is still under rollout while global oil sits near five-month highs.
pakistan.title: Petrol up 88 paisas to Rs382.02, diesel up 53 paisas for Oct 21

pakistan.summary: The KSE-100 closed at 165,151.64, down 814.44 points (-0.49%), after reversing an early rally as Brent crude hit a five-month high near $109 and Houthi attacks revived Gulf risk. Attock Refinery, Systems, HBL, Hub Power and Fauji Fertiliser were the biggest drags; Cnergyico led volumes and foreign investors were net buyers of Rs206m.
pakistan.title: PSX sheds 814 points as oil rally and Gulf tensions drag benchmark

pakistan.summary: 21-year-old Arafat Minhas scored 59 and then ripped through England with 6/40 as Pakistan won the Rawalpindi ODI by 87 runs — the first Pakistani since Shahid Afridi (2013) to score a fifty and take a five-for in the same ODI. Hasan Nawaz's 79 and Faheem Ashraf's 39 lifted Pakistan to 302/9 after a 133/5 wobble.
pakistan.title: Arafat Minhas' 59 and 6/40 powers Pakistan past England by 87 runs

pakistan.summary: Michael Atherton and Nasser Hussain are off the tri-series commentary panel after their Sky Sports interview with Imran Khan's sons about his prison health — a segment PTV cut from its coverage. Atherton says Pakistan is trying to 'airbrush Imran almost out of existence'. Waqar Younis, Urooj Mumtaz, Bazid Khan and Mark Butcher remain on the panel.
pakistan.title: PCB drops Atherton and Hussain from commentary panel after Imran Khan interview row

pakistan.summary: Karachi authorities have pledged full civic and security support for the third World Culture Festival, running Oct 29 to Nov 22 with over 1,000 artists from 150+ countries and 500 Pakistani artists. The programme features theatre, music, painting and dance from 30+ countries including the US, Iran and Russia; schoolchildren will be brought in for cultural exchange.
pakistan.title: Karachi gears up for World Culture Festival: 150 countries, 1,000+ artists from Oct 29
